resources.string: Welcome to Unreel
Unreel is designed to block short-form feeds like Reels and Shorts. You can still use the same apps for messages, search and regular videos.
How feed detection works
Feed detection needs accessibility access to recognise the Reels and Shorts screens in Instagram and YouTube. Going through this guide does not grant access.
Accessibility setup
Feed protection is unavailable in this build. You can finish the guide and explore the app with protection off.
Device settings

Android may restrict accessibility settings for apps installed outside an app store. Battery settings can also affect background services. You can leave your device settings as they are to explore Unreel.

On Xiaomi, Redmi and POCO phones, look for Background autostart in app settings. You can check whether Unreel is allowed to start in the background.
In App management, open Unreel and look for Auto launch or Allow background activity under battery usage.
Look for Autostart in iManager or in app permission settings, then check the entry for Unreel.
Open the battery settings for Unreel and look for Allow background activity. The name varies by OxygenOS version.
In Battery settings, open Background usage limits and check whether Unreel is listed under Sleeping apps or Deep sleeping apps.
In Android’s battery optimisation list, select All apps and find Unreel. Menu names vary by device.
